failures.criterion: CI is green at the head the reviewer reads. The browser rows this change rewrote hold on CI's machine as well as on this pod - a row that races the Inbox's own width switch is this change's to settle, since the switch is what this change introduced.
failures.evidence: CI run 41171179735 at the code head b1e074f1: `lint`, `test`, `contracts`, `docs / build`, `dispatch-browser-multiprocess`, `claude-envoy`, `envoy-client`, `envoy-plugin`, `envoy-smoke`, `pi-envoy`, `pi-legion`, `pi-shared`, `changes` all green; `dispatch` FAILED; `envoy-go` failed too and is not this change's (below). The `dispatch` lane's one red row is `e2e/references.e2e.ts:26 an issue and its ask show a cross-project message and structural backlinks`: `Error: locator.screenshot: Element is not attached to the DOM` at e2e/references.e2e.ts:91, `await askCard.screenshot({ path: desktopAsk })`, taken straight after `await page.setViewportSize({ height: 900, width: 1440 })` (lines 89-91). That is this change's own layout switch: below 1280 px the card lives in the Inbox row, and from 1280 px the row becomes a short row and the card is drawn again in the reading column, so the node the locator resolved at 390 px is unmounted by the resize. Measured on the page rather than inferred: a throwaway probe held the element Playwright holds while it waits for stability, resized 390 -> 1440, and read it back - `before={"connected":true,"inRow":true} after={"connected":false,"inRow":true} cards drawn now=1`. So the screenshot at 1440 races the unmount; it wins on this pod (the row passed in my whole-project run and 3 of 3 times run alone) and lost on CI's machine. The row is one of the 23 files this change rewrote against the pane (commit fe5ad7408). The fix is the row's: after the resize, resolve the card again where this width draws it - the reading column - and wait for it before the screenshot, or take the 1440 shot of the column's card by its own locator. A flaky row that is red at the head leaves the reviewer and the merge gate nothing to read.
